findings.what: Three new labels say twice what their heading or value already says. "IN THE BOX" has a single row labeled "CONTENTS", which restates the heading; the page's own rule prints a one-row group without a label only when the label equals the heading. findings.where: /hemisphere/<tint> Specifications: On the table, Cord, Dimming, Drop, Canopy.
findings.steps: Read Specifications on http://127.0.0.1:4176/hemisphere/ice.
findings.what: Several new lines read as a buyer might stumble over them, though none is wrong. "About 340 lux 20 in (0.5 m) below" runs two figures together ("340 lux 20 in"); "at" would help. "cut to the drop at install" is trade shorthand. "Phase-cut (leading or trailing edge) or 0-10 V" uses electrician's terms; it is the standard US spec-sheet form. In "23.6 in (600 mm) as standard: 30.6 in (776 mm) from the ceiling to the rim" the colon has to be read as "that is"; the arithmetic is right (2.0 + 23.6 + 5.0 = 30.6 in; 50 + 600 + 126 = 776 mm). Canopy is the only row written "5.9 in across, 2.0 in deep (150 x 50 mm)" with the millimeters grouped at the end. Also not in the builder's list: Core's group was renamed "Balls, rating and care" and its "Care" label became "Cleaning", while Hemisphere's similar row is still "Care".
findings.expected: Owner's call.

findings.where: All eight /mantle/<tint> pages, Specifications > Outputs and Plinth/Posts.
findings.steps: Read Specifications on http://127.0.0.1:4176/mantle/haze.
findings.what: "RCA line outputs and an earth post": "earth" is British; the American term is "ground post". The rewritten Plinth row still says "raised 1.6 in (40 mm) on four posts", and the next row says "Four solid posts, 1.2 in (30 mm) across", so the posts are named twice. Both were the same in the build before.
findings.expected: "a ground post". Name the posts in one row only.

Figures are the same across the eight tints of each product, except color words, lumens and kelvin, which differ as in the build before. Hemisphere: 307/353/380/282/270/258/521/260 lm and 2200/4000/4000/2700/4000/3000/2700/4000 K (Ember to Smoke). Core: 45/51/63/38/39/33/95/35 lm, same kelvin pattern.

Every fact in the build before is still on the new pages. Removed, as listed: "the shade glows in its own color" and "the ball lights in its own color". New rows match the builder's list word for word: Hemisphere Size, Weight, Power, Dimming, Cord, Drop, Canopy; Core Use, Color temperature, Runtime, Charging, Cells, Contents, Rating moved; Mantle Plinth (Fog: "Clear cast acrylic ..."), Speeds, Hardware on all eight. tested_and_right: Home: screenshots of every screenful at all 14 sizes (1920x970 to 360x640). I looked at the first screen at every size, and at every screenful at 1920, 1440, 1280, 1024, 844x390, 820x1180, 768x1024, 600x900 and 390x844. No sideways page scroll at any size (scrollWidth equals width) and nothing overlapping.

Item 9 hero, measured: headline, line and both buttons are on the first screen. Buttons end at 777.6 of 800 at 480x800, 636 of 667 at 375x667, 607.8 of 640 at 360x640, 707.8 of 740 at 360x740 and 747.7 of 844 at 390x844. In the build before, they fell below the first screen at 480x800, 375x667 and 360x640.

Item 9 hero, looked at: the capped picture is the same 4:5 frame scaled down (408x510, 301.6x377, 280x350), nothing cut. At 844x390 the line is one line and the buttons stand side by side at y189-233, clear of the pendants (nearest pendant top about y265). The build before stacked them.

Item 8: the renders line's left edge equals the first family tile's left edge at all 14 sizes (x240 at 1920, x16 at every other size). Before, it was offset by 116, 100 or 20 px at 1920, 1440 and 1280.
Family row at 14 sizes: four equal tiles (4 across at 768 and wider, 2x2 at 600 and narrower), pictures whole (at most 0.03% off their own proportions), names on one line, all eight chips present.
Place tiles at 14 sizes: pictures whole (at most 0.31% off), captions are the color names alone, and the row scrolls sideways on phones as before.
Item 11 at 1440x900 (all eight tiles) and 390x844 (Ember, Haze): each tile opens /tropos/<tint> with the Out picture (6/6) shown whole, title "Tropos in <Tint> · EARF", and canonical following.

Item 11 Copy link: on Out it gives /tropos/<tint>?view=out, which opens on Out; the other five views (Front, Horn behind, The amplifier, Turning, At the bar) give /tropos/ember. Back returns to the home page at the same scroll in one step, and on the phone the row's sideways position is restored too.
Copy address on / and /contact at 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x740: the note says "Address copied.", the clipboard holds hello@earf.world, and Enter works the same. On /contact nothing moves.

/contact at 1440x900 and 390x844: "Write to us.", the made-to-order line, the address and Copy address. Links: mailto:hello@earf.world (href read, not followed), the logo to home, and Contact in the footer.

/lighting, item 10, measured at 1920, 1440, 1366, 1280, 1024, 390x844 and 360x740: the eight named dots break four and four in each tile, each name sits under its own dot (centers within 0.1 px), none is cut, targets are at least 45x52, and the buttons stay on one line. The names row's edges equal the picture's edges at every size. The two rows of eight show whole at 3:1 and split four and four on phones.

/lighting clicks at 1440x900: all 16 dots lead to /hemisphere/<tint> or /core/<tint> with the right title, picture, chosen dot and canonical. See Hemisphere, See Core and the tile pictures lead to the visit's tint, and after an Ice visit the tile pictures also show Ice.

visit.js on 4176: RESULT: all hold. Fresh visit Ember; Poison chip; Core tile opens /core/poison; the Haze dot gives /core/haze; header Speakers leads to haze; Back shows Haze; reload keeps Haze. Header items on their own pages do not add history. Hero line and buttons fit at 844x390, 932x430, 960x600, 1440x900, 390x844 and 961x700.

My tint.js on 4176: after the Ice place tile and Back, the home row shows Ice (pictures and links), and reload keeps it. On /hemisphere/haze the header Speakers and Turntable lead to Haze, and the logo returns to a Haze row. Phone (390x844): Fog chip, then Mantle tile (/mantle/fog), then Back keeps Fog. Nothing I found shows one tint while linking to another: the /lighting names row and the hero dots link to the tints they show.

Old addresses on 4176: /#speaker-ice and /colors/ice go to /tropos/ice; /#hemisphere-fog to /hemisphere/fog; /s/core-smoke to /core/smoke; /tropos, /hemisphere, /core and /mantle to their /ember pages (308); /tropos/ice?view=out to /tropos/ice on Out; ?view=nonsense to /tropos/ice on Front; /lighting?x=1 to /lighting. Each has the right title ("<Product> in <Tint> · EARF", "Lighting · EARF"). /tropos/EMBER and /tropos/red give 404 (known). The server answers the same on 4175.
First load, phone 390x844 home: 14 requests, 787 KB, against 26 requests, 1879 KB before. No globe-frames file and no opening film. The header logo looks right at 0.3 s and 3 s.
First load, desktop: the opening still plays at 1440x900. /tropos/ember is 24 requests, 853 KB on phone and desktop, against 31 and 906 before.
What the first screen never shows on the phone home: the four family tiles and the eight place pictures (about 420 KB) are fetched within 120 ms.

The visible text of the home, lighting, speakers and turntable views, the header and the footer is the same as the build before. The title, meta and canonical tags of /, /lighting and /contact are also unchanged.
